title: Apple schedules iPhone event for September 9
description: Months of rumors and leaks later, we finally have a date for Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro series and first foldable iPhone announcement. Apple has confirmed that its iPhone-focused event will take place on September 9 at 10am PT. The company will host an in-person event at Apple Park in Cupertino, California and will livestream the keynote. The event poster features the tagline “Surprise and Shine,” along with a glowing Apple logo that appears to have sunlight shining through it. Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at the event. However, the biggest...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 CAD-based renders leak
description: Yesterday some new CAD-based renders of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra leaked online, and today it's the vanilla Galaxy S27's turn to get the exact same treatment. Immediately you can see a stark difference between the S27 and the S27 Ultra. The top of the line device has a new camera island design, while the entry-level model won't. In fact, the Galaxy S27 looks remarkably similar to the Galaxy S26, with its oval-shaped camera bump that's in the top left corner of the rear. The S27 allegedly measures 149.75 x 71.88 x 7.25 mm, which makes it very very slightly larger than its...

title: Garmin launches the Fenix 9 and Fenix 9 Pro with up to 57 days of battery life
description: Garmin has just launched the Fenix 9 and Fenix 9 Pro smartwatches, with the latter boasting the first full titanium case and largest AMOLED screen in the Fenix line ever. The Fenix 9 has a fiber-reinforced polymer case with a titanium rear cover, and a screen with twice the brightness of its predecessor, with a sapphire crystal on top. It's dive-rated to 40m and has leak-proof buttons. There's also 50% more RAM than on the Fenix 8, and a more powerful map engine with 30% faster panning. The watch has 64GB of storage, twice as much as the Fenix 8. Garmin Fenix 9 official...

title: Xiaomi's Xring O3 examined - at least a two-generations leap in power efficiency
description: Xiaomi announced that the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Fold will be powered by the in-house Xring O3 chip, the successor to the Xring O1. What happened to the O2? Well, the O3 is so good, that Xiaomi skipped a number – that’s only partially a joke as Geekerwan examined the new chip and it says it delivers a two-generations improvement in energy efficiency compared to the O1. The Xring O3 is a contradiction – it uses older tech and yet it looks like it can fight the upcoming Dimensity 9600 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips. For starters, the chip is fabbed by TSMC on a 3nm node called N3P, an...

title: Qualcomm confirms that its next Snapdragon flagship platform will reach 5GHz
description: Qualcomm is set to host its annual Snapdragon Summit next month, where it is expected to unveil two new Snapdragon 8 Elite series chipsets. Ahead of the event, the company has confirmed that its upcoming flagship platform will be the first mobile CPU to hit 5GHz. In an official blog post, Qualcomm revealed that its next-generation flagship mobile platform, expected to be the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Gen 6 Pro, will feature the company’s new Oryon CPU. The new CPU will reach clock speeds of up to 5GHz and features a custom architecture with two prime cores and six performance...

title: Watch the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE launch event here
description: Samsung is hosting a Galaxy Event tomorrow. It will begin at 12 PM UTC, and you can follow it with us by tuning in to the YouTube stream below. Samsung hasn't revealed what this Galaxy Event will cover, but it doesn't take a genius to figure out it's going to be about the Galaxy S26 FE. Samsung hasn't divulged anything about the Galaxy S26 FE; however, previous leaks suggest the smartphone won't look much different from its predecessor, the Galaxy S25 FE. [#InlinePriceWidget,14042,1#] Alongside the Galaxy S26 FE, Samsung may unveil the Galaxy Tab S12 series. You can read...

title: Lenovo Cloud Gaming Handheld G700 is now official with a unique feature
description: The Android handheld gaming console market has been on the rise for the last few years as manufacturers rush to compete with Valve's Steam Deck. We now get Lenovo's first handheld Android gaming console, called the Lenovo Cloud Gaming Handheld G700. One of the standout features of Lenovo's device is the ability to stream offline. Thanks to Lenovo's proprietary Legion Stream protocol, you can stream from a PC without a network connection. The connection works through a dongle, which Lenovo provides with the retail package. You can, of course, still stream from the cloud, for when you...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold appears in new images
description: Xiaomi’s next folding phone just leaked, and it brings the trendy short and wide design. The Xiaomi 18 Fold, which is confirmed to launch in September with the brand-new Xring O3 chipset, emerged in two hands-on images on Weibo. Xiaomi 18 Fold prototype (via Weibo) According to the post, we are looking at an engineering prototype of the Xiaomi 18 Fold, so the final version may look different. The unit in the images features a "Dark Cherry" red color, which is expected to be the hero color of the iPhone 18 Pro series and just about every Android phone in the next few months. We...

title: Realme P4s arrives with a 144Hz display, dual chip, and an 8,000 mAh battery
description: Realme today unveiled the Realme P4s as the newest member of its P4 series, which already includes over half a dozen smartphones. The Realme P4s is built around a 6.77" 144Hz AMOLED display sourced from Samsung and based on M14 OLED tech. It has AGC DT Star D+ glass protection, a 2,772x1,272-pixel resolution, 6,500 nits peak brightness, and HDR10+ support. It also supports wet and oily-hand touch so that you can operate it even with wet or oily hands. Under the hood, the Realme P4s has two chips - the Dimensity 7400 Ultra SoC and the Hyper Vision+ AI Chip. The latter is a dedicated...

title: WhatsApp strengthens two-step verification, adds enhanced call information
description: Today WhatsApp has announced some improved security features. First off, two-step verification is getting stronger. Before, it was a six-digit PIN. From now on, it will be a full password - longer, alphanumeric, and with special characters, making it harder to guess. Next up, call security. When you pick up a call from someone who isn't in your contacts, you'll see more information about the caller, like whether their number is from a different country, or if you have any groups in common. This will help protect against scammers, hopefully. The bad news is that this feature is only coming...

title: Huawei continues Pura X View teasers ahead of official launch
description: The Huawei Pura X View was soft-launched last week, though it will be officially available in China from August 28. Ahead of the big unveiling, Huawei posted another teaser for its wide-screen smartphone. The video goes over the Pura X View’s design and its key selling point – the 6.39-inch OLED screen with its unusually wide 16:9.5 aspect ratio. The panel also features uniform 1.05 mm thin bezels and is unlike any other bar phone currently on the market. We also get more teasers for the phone’s 7,000 mAh battery as well as its 6.68mm thin profile and confirmation of its...

title: vivo X500 Pro and Pro Max telephoto cameras officially detailed
description: After confirming that the vivo X500 series will launch next month, the company has been gradually revealing details about the upcoming phones, particularly the X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. Now, vivo has detailed the telephoto cameras on both models. vivo Product Manager Han Boxiao revealed the new details in separate Weibo posts. The vivo X500 Pro is confirmed to feature a 64MP APO telephoto camera with a custom Sony LYT-610 sensor. It will use a GG 1x1 and RB 2x2 pixel structure, which is claimed to improve focusing performance. According to the vivo executive, the telephoto...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL's bending resistance tested in teardown video
description: Google launched the Pixel 11 Pro XL earlier this month, along with the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold. If you've been wondering how the XL model stands up to scratches, open flames, or attempts to bend it, you're in luck. [#InlinePriceWidget,14800,1#] The video below explores just that, in a traditional "durability test" format, before disassembling the entire handset for your viewing pleasure. So grab some popcorn and/or a beverage of your choice, hit play, and enjoy the ride. The glass scratches at level 6 on the Mohs scale, with deeper grooves appearing at level...

title: vivo V80 Lite 5G debuts with Dimensity 7360 chipset, 7,050 mAh battery
description: vivo has now quietly launched the V80 Lite 5G in Pakistan. This is not to be confused with the V80 Lite 5G that will be landing in India on September 3, since the two look nothing alike. The Pakistani version comes with a 6.83-inch curved POLED display with 1260x2800 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 3,000-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, paired with 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 128/256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. On the rear there's a 50MP main camera and a 2MP depth sensor, while for selfies you get a 32MP snapper. Keeping the lights on is a...

title: After AnTuTu, Qualcomm's upcoming flagship Snapdragon chip appears on Geekbench powering an alleged iQOO 16
description: Qualcomm is hosting its annual Snapdragon Summit next month, from September 22-24 in Hawaii, where it's expected to introduce two new flagship Snapdragon mobile chips. One is rumored to have part number SM8950, while the other is SM8975. The latter was spotted on AnTuTu over a week ago and has now appeared on Geekbench as well. An unnamed device bearing model code vivo V2606A - and believed to be the iQOO 16 - has been listed on the Geekbench database with Android 17, 16GB RAM, and SM8975. The SM8975 was previously called the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro, but tipster Digital Chat Station...

title: Samsung launches One UI 9 beta 6 for the Galaxy S26 series
description: About a couple of weeks after Samsung released the fifth beta of One UI 9 for the Galaxy S26 series, today the company is rolling out the sixth beta build. It's an 851MB update and includes the August 5, 2026 security patches. It's currently available in Germany, India, Poland, the UK, and Korea and should be making its way to the US soon. If you are part of the beta program, once you've installed the sixth beta, your phone will be running build ZZHE. It includes fixes for display errors with the Now Brief widget and the home screen, photo-saving issues in Expert RAW 24MP at some focal...

title: Leakster details the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro and Dimensity 9600 Pro flagship chipsets
description: We already saw Xiaomi’s new chipset post some impressive results, but it’s held back by some older tech – it’s a 3nm chip (TSMC N3P) and uses Arm C1 cores. The upcoming chips from Qualcomm and MediaTek promise to be even better, though neither company has revealed official details yet. So instead, leakster Digital Chat Station offers a preview. The "Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6", which we assume means the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro (SM8975), will be fabbed on TSMC’s new 2nm node (N2P). The CPU will crack the 5GHz barrier with its two Prime cores clocked at 5.01GHz. The 8-core CPU...

title: Take a look at the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra in some fresh high-quality CAD renders
description: Yesterday a rough CAD render of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra leaked, and now we have a set of much more polished and higher-resolution renders of the device to look at. As is obvious from the very first look, Samsung is redesigning the camera island, opting for an Apple-like (or rather, Poco-like for those who remember) big rectangle up top, with the camera sensors housed in its left side. According to the source of these renders, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will measure 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97 mm, which makes it imperceptibly larger than its predecessor on all three axes....

title: Xiaomi wins EISA Smartphone award, Honor, Oppo, and Samsung get some love as well
description: EISA, the Expert Imaging and Sound Association, has announced its latest 2026-2027 smartphone awards. These are basically voted on by multiple EISA member publications, which have tested the products during the year using their own criteria, and there are at least five EISA member publications that have reviewed each device. Xiaomi 17T Pro The Xiaomi 17T Pro won the EISA Smartphone award, thanks to its camera system, display, flagship chipset, and long-lasting battery. The Honor Magic V6 won the EISA Foldable Smartphone award, thanks to its class-leading battery capacity, IP ratings,...

title: Samsung's updated Smart Switch is easier to use and copies more data
description: Samsung’s latest One UI 9 makes switching phones easier – the updated Smart Switch app now has a simpler set-up process and it can copy more data too. If you are moving from an iPhone to a Galaxy Z8 foldable, you no longer need to install Smart Switch on the iPhone. The app on the Android side will generate a QR code that you scan with the iPhone’s camera app, then you need to confirm a few options and you’re ready to go. Even better, the new app is able to copy more data from your old iPhone – the transfer now includes passwords and passkeys, call history, accessibility settings...
